regression_repair.repair_scope: Clause-aware focus overrides flat recency only when the legacy state cannot supply one unique referent or the focus state is structurally multi-centered. Explicit topic returns and simple single-referent pronouns retain their sealed response and binding contracts.

mechanisms: DiscourseFocusStateIR stores a bounded hash-bound set of PRIMARY, SECONDARY, and BACKGROUND centers plus typed focus transitions.
Focus candidates retain their source frame, ClauseGraph clause, clause function, governing relation, salience, and non-authoritative evidence.
Coordinate, sequence, contrast, and subordinate-nucleus structures select their discourse center from typed clause structure rather than flat mention recency.
A contrast edge can select its viable target clause as the conversational pivot without treating two structurally related directives as an unresolved intent competition.
Backchannels and gratitude preserve an existing multi-clause focus; the Korean acknowledgement form `알겠어` is normalized as a dialogue act rather than a new world-model subject.
Generic `it` and `그것` use clause-aware focus only as a bounded fallback when legacy recency has no unique referent; expletive and multiple-pronoun cases remain outside that shortcut.
Every focus node and transition forces semantic_authority=false and external_execution_authorized=false.
next_program_order: deixis and ellipsis resolution against typed discourse focus
next_residual: general bridging reference and implicit argument recovery
calibrated ambiguity preservation for more than one compatible focus
broad indirect speech-act inference without authority leakage
